lesson_text: A Claude-fixer hand-off with 0 ledger findings and `failed_checks=none` is a check-snapshot timeout, not a review result: the clean-review auto-merge waits 300s for every other check run on the head, including a sibling review run on the same head. Record the round and push the next legitimate change (base merge or log update) so a new head is reviewed; never post a verdict for findings that do not exist.
